exposure: Women with and without maternal cardiac disease
cohort: 14,160 deliveries, including 218 with maternal cardiac disease
finding: While maternal cardiac disease was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery, most cesarean deliveries were performed for obstetric indications, and cesarean delivery in the setting of maternal cardiac disease was associated with high rates of severe maternal morbidity.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in women with maternal cardiac disease.
